verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no native incident declaration, incident timelines, on-call schedules, or escalation policies in Sentry. It only offers alert rules that notify, create tickets, or call webhooks, plus integrations that hand incident work off to PagerDuty for paging and incident.io for managing Sentry issues. Missing for 10: native incident declaration and tracking, incident timelines, on-call scheduling, escalation policies, and any evidence beyond forwarding alerts to third-party incident tools.
